tree.organization_pattern: category-based top level (recipes, extensions, skills, integrations, schemas, primitives, dashboards, docs) with flat contribution subfolders; dashboards use framework-native nested routing

patterns_observed: Top-level folders are category names (recipes, extensions, skills, integrations, schemas, primitives, dashboards, docs, server, resources)
Each contribution lives in its own named subfolder under the appropriate category
Contribution names are descriptive kebab-case slugs describing the capability
A _template folder exists in every open contribution category as a starter scaffold
Dashboards use framework-native routing conventions: SvelteKit uses src/routes/, Next.js uses app/ with [id] dynamic segments
Some skills use variants/, references/, scripts/ subfolders for richer contributions
Some recipes include scripts/, sql/, src/, server/, curriculum/ subfolders when they are full applications

primary_entry.reason: The canonical Open Brain MCP server. All AI clients (Claude Desktop, claude.ai, any MCP-compatible client) connect to this. Every other entry point is either a variant of this server or a one-time data migration/enrichment script.

operational_facts.database: Supabase + pgvector, core thoughts table with vector(1536) embeddings
operational_facts.health_endpoint_pattern: GET * → {status: 'ok'} on all Edge Function servers
